description: [Payment decision: may this agent pay, plus an audit record] May this agent pay this seller, under the buyer's rules? One call runs the spend-policy check and the x402 seller reputation check and returns one verdict (pay / dont_pay / ask_human), the reasons, both sub-results, and an audit record. The record is a receipt header plus decisionReceipt; signing is OFF today, so the receipt is unsigned (X-GW8-Receipt-Alg: none). Check GET /.well-known/gw8-receipt-key and do not treat the record as a signed proof until `enabled` is true. Deterministic; stateless; never pays anyone. Free when the seller data source is down. $0.02. Paid: $0.02 USDC on Base, paid in-band via x402 MCP (@x402/mcp; _meta "x402/payment"). Also at POST https://micro-saas-agent.onrender.com/api/pay/should-i-pay.
